title: sixty-second-read seed envelope
description: The read is the SEED (witness 2026-08-29). Four beats exactly: bet -> outcome -> spark -> move, plus provenance refs and seed_state. Every longer form (NFTT post, atlas entry) is a condition-gated resynthesis committed against this object via the Yoav Protocol; read-time tiers are altitudes of ONE serialized object. Enforced mechanically by scripts/sixty_second_read.py (validate + gate); this file is the documented contract.

seed_state.description: dormant = read committed, no resynthesis; sprouted = first condition-gated longer form committed; grown = full family. A dormant seed is never garbage-collected.

ref.description: key that beat source_refs point at

desc.description: what the source is (transcript id, SSOT path, DM thread)

verified.description: when/how the source was actually READ (not a memory jog). Empty = gate failure.

filed.description: ISO date the bet was filed; gate requires filed <= outcome.date

cards.description: mark the honest miss card with miss: true

spark.description: The distinct fourth beat: the ignition moment where recognition fired. Canon: the sparkplug (chan-suh SSOT + ADR-053) converts the counterpart's OWN stored potential to kinetic with a small, precisely timed spark; the energy was theirs the whole time. Evidence-anchored: a verbatim quote, never a mood.

move.description: ONE move, never a menu (gate blocks list tags and menu tells).

math.description: Math-on-pull: rendered inside a <details> closed by default.

nci.description: optional decision-level grade passed through to settle/KINTSUGI; never fabricated

gap.description: 'on target' renders green; anything else renders amber

germination.description: Germination conditions as UNIVERSAL AXES with per-seed RANGES (witness 2026-08-29): the dimensions are objective and shared by every seed; only the ranges are per-seed and EARNED from settled outcomes, never decreed. Ripeness = mechanical range-check of a context vector (scripts/sixty_second_read.py ripeness). Sprout commits require RIPE; every sprouted/refused decision is appended to _SEEDS/ledger.jsonl with the conditions_present snapshot.

ranges_provenance.description: provisional = declared before any settled outcome; earned = calibrated from settled outcomes

oxygen.description: live demand: an open question the seed answers

light.description: exposure regime: dark-requiring seeds are internal-first (low range), light-requiring seeds are public (high range)

stratification.description: required dormancy; requires_gauntlet = serotiny (opens only under adversarial fire)

future_vector.description: The dormant seed's superposition of possible longer forms (Yoav FutureVector states). Each resynthesis collapses one; conditions are the germination gate (resolved? counterpart-safe? window open?).

range.description: [lo, hi], 0..1; omit the axis to leave it unconstrained
